correctness.rationale: The state space is exhausted by all 15-duad perfect matching assignments (288 unique) and independently by full 30-vertex edge recursion. All 90 canonical graph eight-cycles are enumerated. Both cycle-based and every-pair matching-difference enumerations produce exactly 1440 legal edges, with independent C++ connected degree-two certification for each 8-edge difference. Two separately implemented BFS approaches visit all 288 states from each source and yield the exact two profile tables; outputs and full finite certificate are present. Thus this is a fully checked finite theorem, not extrapolation from experiments.

value.rationale: The shortest possible alternating cycles are canonical minimal local moves in this girth-eight cubic bipartite graph. The theorem determines universal reachability of perfect matchings by feasible local operations, a sharp diameter-six guarantee, and a nonuniform center/periphery that exactly follows the two canonical complementary 2-factor types. This structural information is motivated and not a routine consequence of matching counts; its exact graph-specific value is intrinsic even without an infinite-family theorem.
